photo_brief.what: Official rendering of Rosewood Residences Bangkok (tower facing Lumphini Park)

post_text:
@Rosewood Hotel Group is taking its residential brand to Southeast Asia for the first time, with Rosewood Residences Bangkok.

Announced on 28 October, the project counts 85 private residences across 37 floors on Rama 4 Road, overlooking Lumphini Park.

It is developed by @SC Asset with Tokyo Tatemono Thailand, the Thai arm of the Japanese developer Tokyo Tatemono. Owners will have Rosewood's residential service and access to its hotels and resorts worldwide.

Sonia Cheng, Chief Executive Officer of Rosewood Hotel Group, calls it an address "intended to be valued for generations to come". Nuttaphong Kunakornwong, CEO of SC Asset, leads the developer's side.

The signal: branded residences have become a business of their own. In Thailand alone, the market is worth 205.3 billion baht (US$6.4 billion), according to C9 Hotelworks. For a hotel brand, a residence turns a few nights into a long relationship.

Would you buy a branded residence for the brand, or for the address?
